purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: An official Qarshi city decision listed land parcels for online auction with cadastral numbers and local neighborhood names, confirming cadastral administration for city land. Uzbekistan’s official National Geo-information Portal provides a cadastral-number search and official map platform, but the layer list is not exposed until interaction/sign-in and no anonymous geometry-only query was verified. No auction parcel was queried or retained. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
